name: Current
subtitle: Network speeds for your Dynamic Island
description: The official Current source for AltStore Classic, SideStore and FlareStore. Download the latest iPhone build and receive version updates from the Current GitHub releases.

apps.name: Current
apps.subtitle: Upload and download speeds at a glance
apps.localizedDescription: Current measures Wi-Fi and cellular traffic with a live chart, a Dynamic Island Live Activity and small/medium Home Screen widgets. An optional experimental low-accuracy location session may help monitoring continue when other apps are open, but iOS can still suspend it. Current never stores or sends your location. Requires iOS 18 or later. Signing both the app and its widget with compatible App Group entitlements is necessary for shared widget readings.

versions.localizedDescription: Automated build of Current for iPhone.

privacy.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Current can use low-accuracy location updates, with your permission, to try to keep optional network monitoring active in the background. Current never saves or sends your location.
